text: {"assertions":["An infinite recursion bug was discovered in graph/traversal/walker.rs on 2026-05-17.","The walker.rs infinite recursion bug only appeared after a rolling restart of the fleet.","The root cause of the walker.rs infinite recursion was two writes not wrapped in a transaction.","The walker.rs infinite recursion was fixed by wrapping both writes in a single transaction (PR #1392, branch fix/infinite-recursion-1).","The walker.rs infinite recursion bug can be reproduced by walking a cyclic fixture graph.","The stack guard trip was the signal indicating the infinite recursion in walker.rs.","A module test block in graph/traversal/walker.rs covers the infinite recursion fix.","The deployed walker.rs fix cleared the backlog within 45 minutes."]}
